name: @magpie-community/page-codex-guard
description: 在 magpie 窗口里加一个「Codex 守护」页面：体检 Codex 桌面端的登录态状态文件，随时快照与恢复被登出清空的项目与会话归属，显示 codex 账号的 5 小时 / 7 天额度与路由现状。A page in magpie's window that checks Codex's account-state file, snapshots and restores the project and session assignments a sign-out wipes, and shows the codex account's 5-hour and 7-day windows and the routing in effect.
author: InvisibleGuardian007

summary.en: Codex desktop keeps its projects and session assignments in .codex/.codex-global-state.json, keyed by the signed-in account: a sign-out rewrites it as an anonymous copy with no projects, so the sidebar shows nothing. This page classifies that file, snapshots it, restores it (optionally by itself, every 20 seconds), and shows the codex account's 5-hour and 7-day windows plus the routing in effect.
summary.zh: Codex 桌面端把项目和会话归属存在 .codex/.codex-global-state.json，并按登录态分版本：一登出就被改写成没有项目的匿名版，侧边栏于是空掉。这个页面判断该文件的状态、快照与恢复（可选每 20 秒自动恢复），并显示 codex 账号的 5 小时 / 7 天额度和当前路由。
